method: Reviewed original variable-frame-rate video frames, including consecutive last-cover and first-editor frames. Decoded every encoded frame and checked all pre-editor body frames after 0.7 seconds for content changes; only the appropriate cover and spinner were present. Fixed 12 fps PNG exports were not used as the sole evidence.
timestampDefinition: best_effort_timestamp / stream time_base, relative to video start.
